name: Luminous Gear Oasis
description: An oasis where ancient brass gears turn silently, powering luminous flowers that bloom in rhythm.
prompt: A desert oasis centered around a pool of glowing water. Around it, large brass gears interlock and rotate slowly, each gear driving a cluster of luminous flowers that open and close in perfect sync. Warm golden light, sand dunes backdrop, 8k.
caption: Mechanics and nature in harmonious glow. ⚙️🌼
